headline: Smart home device failures signal risks for connected healthcare systems
body: The smart home industry is experiencing widespread product failures and manufacturer shutdowns, creating a cautionary tale for healthcare AI vendors. As remote monitoring devices and connected health platforms proliferate, the same reliability issues plaguing consumer IoT reveal critical vulnerabilities in how healthcare organizations depend on third-party ecosystems. For healthcare AI implementations relying on connected devices and external data pipelines, this trend underscores the importance of vendor sustainability vetting and data resilience strategies. Consulting teams should pressure clients to evaluate exit strategies and data portability for any AI health solution dependent on hardware or software continuity. The market consolidation in remote cardiac monitoring and connected care demonstrates healthcare cannot afford the "move fast and break things" approach that characterizes consumer tech.
